title: Adapted From Hikmet Hükümenoğlu’s Novel, Ece Yörenç’s 'Hide and See!' Premieres on Netflix on December 17
body_markdown:
Netflix has announced, along with the first-look images from the series, that


Hide and See!


will premiere on


December 17


. Created and written by


Ece Yörenç


, adapted from


Hikmet Hükümenoğlu


’s novel of the same name, directed by


Bertan Başaran


and produced by


Ay Yapım


.


Along with the first images from the series, Netflix announced that the limited series


Hide and See!


, created and written by


Ece Yörenç


, adapted from


Hikmet Hükümenoğlu


’s novel, directed by


Bertan Başaran


and produced by


Ay Yapım


, will premiere on


December 17


.


Click


[here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Vz-1adkoD3I9hA-wHYh1HD_C5Qe-cy_c) to download the first images from the series.


Bringing together a beloved ensemble cast of


Şevval Sam, Okan Yalabık, Mert Fırat, Uğur Aslan, Serkan Keskin, Cem Yiğit Üzümoğlu, Başak Daşman, Berk Özgür, Efe Tunçer, Fırat Çelik, Yağmur Başkurt, Burcu Söyler, Tayfun Eraslan, Baran Andıç, Berfu Halisdemir, Fatih Sönmez, Eren Pekgöz, Volkan Cal


and


Çiğdem Selışık Onat


, the series follows a renowned journalist who returns after many years to Yenibelde, the town where they grew up, and sets out to uncover the truth behind the mysterious death of a young woman. As the investigation deepens, secrets the town has kept hidden for years come to light one by one, and the journalist is forced to confront their own past.


Hide and See!


premieres on


December 17


, only on Netflix.


About


Hide and See


:


Adapted from Hikmet Hükümenoğlu’s novel


Sonra Gözler Görür,


Hide and See!


follows the town of Yenibelde as it is shaken by the mysterious death of a young woman. A renowned journalist returns to the town where she grew up after many years, and as she track down the crime, she uncovers not only a killer but also secrets long swept under the rug, and her own past.


Created & Written by:


Ece Yörenç


Writer:


Hikmet Hükümenoğlu


Director:


Bertan Başaran


Producer:


Kerem Çatay


Production Company:


Ay Yapım


Cast:


Şevval Sam, Okan Yalabık, Mert Fırat, Uğur Aslan, Serkan Keskin, Cem Yiğit Üzümoğlu, Başak Daşman, Berk Özgür, Efe Tunçer, Fırat Çelik, Yağmur Başkurt, Burcu Söyler, Tayfun Eraslan, Baran Andıç, Berfu Halisdemir, Fatih Sönmez, Eren Pekgöz, Volkan Cal and Çiğdem Selışık Onat
